video_title: EXCLUSIVE: Bronny James on Being a VETERAN on the Lakers - Mason & Ireland at Lakers Media Day

quotes.speaker: Bronny James
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James on his biggest improvement since joining the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think just decision making and being able to read the game while it's happening in full speed.
quotes.quote: I think just decision making and being able to read the game while it's happening in full speed. I think just reps and getting out there and playing with the team has just helped me get in rhythm and know what to do when things happen. Being able to play with guys like Luka, my dad, and learn from them has been great for me.

quotes.speaker: Bronny James
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James on his veteran role with the new Lakers roster
quotes.excerpt: Vando told me earlier that I'm a vet on the team now.
quotes.quote: They told me that I'm one of the standing, one of the only people that have been here for a few years. Vando told me earlier that I'm a vet on the team now. So, making an example that I'm here to work, I'm here to grind for a spot, and do all the things that the team needs me to do.

quotes.speaker: Bronny James
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James on learning from teammate Max Christie
quotes.excerpt: I think Max for me, I play against him, that's my matchup in practice.
quotes.quote: I think Max for me, I play against him, that's my matchup in practice. He's one of the guys that I should be looking after and learn from. I have been doing that over the summer, we've been talking and getting shots up together. I think he's one of the guys that I should be looking after.
